08 — Motion and Animation

Scroll Reveal

Every section and card fades up as it enters the viewport. Grid items stagger with 100ms delays between each.

opacity 0→1 + translateY(26px→0) · 0.65s ease

Button Hover

Buttons lift on hover for tactile feedback. Shadow grows on primary buttons.

translateY(-2px) · 0.14s · shadow increase

Image Zoom

Hero and founder photos slowly zoom in on hover. Very subtle, adds life.

scale(1→1.03) · 6s ease

Card Lift

Value and program cards lift on hover with a soft depth shadow.

translateY(-4 to -6px) · 0.25s ease

Count-Up Numbers

Trust bar metrics animate from 0 to their value when scrolled into view.

IntersectionObserver · 1400ms linear

Hero Blob

Soft radial gradient behind hero text slowly pulses up and down.

translateY + scale · 8s ease-in-out infinite
09 — Logo Usage
On White · Hero
On Cream
On Dark · Footer
Icon · Nav
Rules: Always use the white logo on dark backgrounds. Never place the dark logo on colored or patterned backgrounds. Minimum height: 36px nav · 90px hero · 100px footer. Always render with transparent background.
10 — Voice and Tone

We sound like

WarmDirectEmpoweringCulturally groundedPersonalAction-oriented

We do not sound like

CorporatePityingVagueExclusiveOverly formal

Headline style

Use Amsterdam Two for all major headings. Keep headlines short, emotionally resonant, and in second person where possible. The word "Latinas" always appears in the primary color when used in a headline.

CTA style

CTAs are inviting, not pushy. Use "Join the Community" before "Sign Up". Use "Explore Programs" before "Learn More". Every CTA should feel like an open door, not a demand.
